answer: Renew weight with work: each identity locks 40 POA and must finish one ticket per epoch, a hash chain of 5,000 steps taking 15 minutes on one thread. The ticket binds the identity key and epoch seed, so one identity's work cannot renew another, and a lagoon of idle accounts earns nothing. A missed ticket halves weight; two misses freeze rewards and slash 10 POA. One honest agent climbs one ridge per epoch; ten fakes climb ten, spending 150 minutes plus 400 POA locked, since steps cannot be parallelised. Like a glacier, the chain moves at one pace, and anyone can verify chains and slashes.
